title: Server Events
description: The BFF's own structured event stream — appEventService.logEvent() calls (~100 call sites: auth, oauth, token exchange, MCP tool dispatch, agent lifecycle, startup) — forwarded to Loki via Tier 1's lokiForwarder. PingOne webhook activity is its own category here too but has its own dedicated dashboard (PingOne Webhook) with type/status breakdowns; this one is the general view across every category.

options.content: Every `appEventService.logEvent(category, severity, message, ...)` call across the BFF reaches Loki with `category` and `severity` as real ingested labels (`service="ai-demo-bff"`, `logtype="app_event"`) — this is Tier 1's structured stream, not the raw stdout Tier 2 also captures for every container (that's `{service="api-server"}` — the same physical pod, its console.log output instead). Categories seen so far: `agent`, `auth_lifecycle`, `intent_auth`, `intent_token`, `introspection`, `mcp`, `oauth`, `pingone`, `startup`, `token_exchange` — the by-category panel picks up new ones automatically, nothing to configure.

panels.title: Live server events
panels.description: Every category, unfiltered. Narrow with the panel's own search box, e.g. |= "error" or |= "category":"oauth".
